description: SATUSEHAT Data is the Indonesian Ministry of Health's portal for its One Health Data initiative, drawing on the national SATUSEHAT health information exchange. The home page read on 2026-09-28 offers interactive dashboards on the most visited health topics, public dashboards that need no login for academics, practitioners and the general public, and views for provincial and district health offices and for health facilities that track disease trends; it says data can be accessed and downloaded as needed, and names its sources as SATUSEHAT and a survey by the Directorate General of Health Services on electronic medical record availability in health facilities. Coverage is Indonesia. Access to the public dashboards is free; no licence is stated on the home page, and the individual datasets and download formats were not opened. Caveats: the page is in Indonesian, content behind the dashboards was not read, and figures depend on facility reporting to SATUSEHAT. It supports health service planning and emergency studies, such as mapping disease trends or digital readiness of health facilities by district before a disaster. No related Indonesian health data record is catalogued.
